test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

I. All books are pencils.

II. All pencils are cardboards.

III. All cardboards are notebooks.

Conclusions:

I. Some notebooks are pencils.

II. Some cardboards are books.

III. Some notebooks are books.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
All conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b9bca9265aadc675a86e53ef920f71b3a6d163432a550958a7cb3a5dd8c1ad0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some notebooks are pencils → Follow (As all pencils are cardboards and all cardboards are notebooks. As whole pencils comes in cardboards which whole comes in notebooks, therefore it is true)

II. Some cardboards are books → Follow (As all books are pencils and all pencils are cardboards. As whole books comes in pencils which whole comes in cardboards, therefore it is true)

III. Some notebooks are books → Follow (As all books are pencils, all pencils are cardboards and all cardboards are notebooks. As whole books comes in pencils which whole comes in cardboards which whole comes in notebooks, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, All conclusions I, II and III follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
